'''Rats''' can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] from [[Turael]] and [[Spria]]. They have no requirements to be assigned. There are a wide variety of rats that can count toward the task, but the most commonly killed are [[rat]]s and [[giant rat]]s, which are low-level, rarely deal damage, and practically ubiquitous. It is recommended to use [[Rat bone weapons]] as it has greatly increased effectiveness against rats.

[[Scurrius]] can be fought for greater experience and profit, although his minions will also decrement the task, reducing how many times the boss can be fought on task. [[Brine rat]]s are accessible during [[Olaf's Quest]], and drop [[medium clue]]s and the elusive [[brine sabre]].

[[Hell-rat behemoth]]s can be accessed after [[Freeing Evil Dave]], and drop full spice shakers for [[spicy stew]]s. [[Crypt rat]] and [[giant crypt rat]] variations require completion of [[Priest in Peril]] for access to [[Morytania]] and may be slain by players for the higher [[Slayer]] experience reward or for changing their reward potential inside the [[Barrows|Barrows minigame]].
